## Data Guides
- [Geofences](https://www.precisely.com/data-guide/products/geofences/): Precisely's geofence datasets deliver precise polygon boundaries around real\-world locations that power precision marketing, real estate analysis, emergency response planning, and location\-based consumer engagement\. 
- [ZIP Codes and Carrier Routes](https://www.precisely.com/data-guide/products/usps-zip-codes-plus-four-carrier-routes/): The content describes multiple datasets related to USPS ZIP Codes, including Carrier Routes, ZIP Plus 4s, and ZIP Code Boundaries and Centroids\. ZIP Plus 4s identify over 60 million deliverable USPS ZIP Plus 4s and correlate with U\.S\. census block data\. ZIP Code Boundaries provide spatial demarcations and include centroids, while Carrier Routes represent areas served by USPS mail carriers, following roads for accuracy\.
- [World Time Zone Boundaries](https://www.precisely.com/data-guide/products/world-time-zone-boundaries-utc-map/): World Time Zone Boundaries provides spatial representation of the world’s lands and waters by time zone, showing each time zone’s deviation in hours from Coordinated Universal Time \(UTC\) and Daylight Saving Time \(DST\)\. Each time zone is divided by country \(or parts of countries\) and associated with the start and end dates/times of daylight saving time\.
- [World Postcode and Administrative Boundaries](https://www.precisely.com/data-guide/products/world-postcode-and-administrative-boundaries/): World Postcode and Administrative Boundaries provides comprehensive coverage of global administrative and postcode boundaries, offering six administrative levels for analysis specific to each country, such as township or city boundaries\. It includes administrative hierarchy and alternate postal names for the U\.S\. and Australia, aggregating worldwide postal and administrative boundaries into a single product with a consistent, single table structure format for ease of use\.
- [World Points of Interest – Premium – Consumer](https://www.precisely.com/data-guide/products/world-points-of-interest-premium-consumer/): The World Points of Interest Premium Consumer dataset provides location and detailed company information for consumer\-focused retail and service businesses, leisure, landmarks, and geographic features in more than 175 countries and territories\. It includes a unique identifier, PreciselyID, for each addressable POI to streamline data management and enrichment\.

- [EngageOne™ RapidCX](https://www.precisely.com/product/engageone-rapidcx/engageone-rapidcx/): Personalize, automate, archive, and audit customer communications in one platform with EngageOne RapidCX\.

See their stories
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
What Makes Data 
Agentic-Ready
?
AI agents are only as trustworthy as the data they act on. Most enterprise data isn’t ready. Agentic-Ready Data is visible, reliable, accountable, and complete.  That’s the higher standard AI needs to operate with confidence.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
UNIFIED
Make your data visible
Enterprise data exists across every signal and every system, but not always in a way AI can see or understand. Make it available, connected, and easy to navigate so AI can discover and use it wherever decisions are made.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
HIGH QUALITY
Make your data reliable
Agents move fast, and AI doesn’t pause to validate bad inputs. Keep your data accurate, complete, consistent, and continuously monitored so every AI decision starts with trusted information.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
GOVERNED
Make your data accountable
As AI starts acting on your behalf, transparency and control become non-negotiable. Make every AI decision based on data that is traceable, explainable, and governed by business policies, so AI operates responsibly.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
ENRICHED
Make your data complete
Your internal data alone isn’t enough for agentic AI. Adding rich location, business, and consumer context gives AI the complete picture it needs to understand, reason, and act with confidence.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Data must meet all these conditions continuously, wherever decisions are made. The Precisely Data Integrity Suite makes your data AI-ready in one unified system, so agents can drive business outcomes at enterprise scale.
Explore the Data Integrity Suite
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Data Integrity Suite
Precisely delivers the data integrity required for Agentic AI so every workflow and decision runs on data you can trust. One powerful solution that helps you move faster and reduce risk today, while preparing you for what’s next.
